purpose: Close every r7 independent-QA P0/P1/P2 finding without changing the prospectively frozen Cycle-1 science or consuming its one physical attempt.

canonical_live_self_authorization.rule: The worker opens each canonical live file itself with a retained Windows read handle denying write/delete, validates exact path and FileId, parses the exact held bytes, and compares their digests to the authenticated parent pipe frame. Private snapshot copies and the transport manifest are never authority.
canonical_live_self_authorization.parent_capability: The parent passes an inherited anonymous one-way pipe, a real parent-process handle, and the already-open canonical claim handle. A random 32-byte capability is transmitted only through the pipe; its raw bytes never appear in CLI, environment, claim, manifest, journal, stdout, stderr, or a filesystem file.
canonical_live_self_authorization.true_parent: The worker must prove the OS-reported inherited parent PID equals the process-handle PID and claim parent PID, and that creation FILETIME and image identity match. Direct worker entry, a copied worker, an unrelated live PID, and PID reuse fail before any namespace mutation or science.

fully_isolated_python_home.rule: The parent builds an execution-only Python home by byte-copying the sealed base python executable, every root Python and VC runtime DLL, complete stdlib and DLLs/native/resource closure, and no live site-packages. The existing isolated 12-distribution plus tzdata runtime is attached only after the copied interpreter has authenticated it.
fully_isolated_python_home.launch: The worker is launched by the copied python.exe with exactly -I -S -B; PYTHONHOME, PYTHONPATH, PYTHONUSERBASE and startup hooks are removed. No live PythonHome/Lib or user-writable pre-authorization project code may execute.
fully_isolated_python_home.initial_map_rule: Before any project/numerical import, enumerate the worker memory map and require every non-system executable, DLL, and PYD—including VC runtime—to be in the held isolated Python-home/runtime inventories.

bootstrap_time_firewall.rule: Before isolated tzdata activation only integer epoch-nanosecond, monotonic-clock, ASCII/UTF-8 wire, hashing, held-handle, process-identity and exact-tree operations are allowed. ZoneInfo, KST conversion and local-time formatting are forbidden until verified tzdata is active.

worker_lifetime_holds_and_directory_free.rule: The worker itself opens and retains every private snapshot, isolated Python-home, isolated third-party runtime, live training source, authority and claim file for its full lifetime. Parent holds are additional evidence, not a substitute.
worker_lifetime_holds_and_directory_free.directory_rule: Every destination directory participating in module or native resolution is held with write/delete-denying Windows directory handles and protected by exact-tree checkpoints/import guards until all implicit native dependencies are loaded. A real concurrent file-insertion probe must be denied before authorization.

freshness_nonce_and_supervision.execute_start: Capture parent execute-start epoch_ns and monotonic_ns at the first statement of execute_parent, before authorization or inventory work.
freshness_nonce_and_supervision.deadline: Claim created_epoch_ns equals execute-start epoch_ns; deadline-created is exactly 21600 seconds. Both parent and worker enforce created<=now<deadline, a maximum 300-second launch age, and a monotonic 21600-second ceiling that copy time cannot extend.
freshness_nonce_and_supervision.nonce: Exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters encoding 32 random bytes; any malformed or previously claimed nonce is rejected. Any existing full or partial canonical claim permanently blocks replay.

required_zero_operation_tests: direct hidden worker fails canonical self-authorization before namespace mutation
copied hidden worker fails canonical self-authorization before namespace mutation
absent canonical actual authorization fails before namespace mutation
unrelated live parent and PID-reuse identities fail
future or stale creation timestamps fail and exact 21600-second span is enforced
malformed or reused launch nonce fails
copied Python home starts exact -I -S -B and resolves Asia/Seoul only after sealed tzdata activation
initial native map includes exact sealed VC runtime
concurrent directory insertion during implicit DLL loading is denied
every unauthorized path leaves the canonical namespace byte-for-byte unchanged
all inherited r6 and r7 scientific and target-firewall tests remain passing
